title: Two shores. Different pictures.
evidence: Authored synthetic replay plus optional local Raivari transport workbench. Workbench observations individually identify synthetic samples or public Digitraffic AIS captures; stations remain illustrative.

reusedGeometry.license: Public domain; Natural Earth. Original source and processing metadata retained in file.

raivariBasis.reuse: Replay and provenance semantics informed this original public implementation. Only public-domain coastline geometry was copied. No private application source or dataset recording is published.

localTransport.queue: createOfflineQueue, one SQLite database per station
localTransport.delivery: createBurstSync, actual loopback HTTP/CBOR, persistent receiver deduplication and individual attempt/receipt journals

ais.mode: Explicit REST captures, up to ten new reports per capture; no background collector
ais.sourceTimestamp: timestampExternal preserved; not claimed as a verified vessel clock
ais.limits: Reports older than ten minutes, future dated, invalid or outside extent excluded with counts. Source coordinates retained. Shared public AIS source is not independent corroboration.

research.title: Data Quality Framework for the Alliance
research.influence: Separate timeliness, uniqueness, source and lineage; no conformance claim.

research.title: Continuous-discrete multiple target tracking with out-of-sequence measurements
research.influence: Separate historical state from receipt order. No Bayesian tracking algorithm implemented.

research.title: Fusion of Sensor Measurements and Target-Provided Information in Multitarget Tracking
research.influence: Separate sensing and cooperative reports, asynchronous arrivals. No fusion or identity inference.

research.title: Cyber-resilience for marine navigation by information fusion and change detection
research.influence: Compare baseline and altered run. No spoofing detection implemented or validated.

research.title: Sea Signals: Baltic data at CWIX25
research.influence: Baltic interoperability context only; no representation of exercise stations.

research.title: HAXR multi-station radar dataset
research.influence: One shared AIS stream is not independent station corroboration. No HAXR data plotted in this specimen.

limits: Sixteen authored observations of one fixture-assigned contact.
Consistent clocks assumed, no inferred clock correction.
One directional relay interruption; local observations continue.
Freshness is observation age, not time since delivery.
Hindsight is explicitly bounded to receipts by 12:12:00.
Retry preserves identity; latest observation does not roll back on late arrival.
Unsigned JSON export includes full scenario, including future events, and separately filtered snapshots.
No sensor processing, operational validation, operator study, NATO certification or endorsement.

raivariReview.scope: Focused source and contract review, not an exhaustive repository or security audit. No claim that all Raivari subsystems were runtime-tested.

pieces.existing: Validated recording adapter, causal replaySlice and immutable sensor-scoped applyDropout.
pieces.useHere: Carries forward recorded-clock and unchanged-baseline semantics. This interruption delays relay delivery; it does not call sensor dropout or remove the source observation.
pieces.integration: Keep source event time and original frame index when adapting a real recording.

pieces.existing: Two-station source availability with a causal evaluation cohort and explicit shared-AIS-source limits.
pieces.useHere: Per-station records and separate source identity. Adds station receipt time, which the HAXR availability comparison does not supply.
pieces.integration: Do not interpret station file membership as measured network arrival.

pieces.existing: Bounded dataset parser, provenance validation and causal AIS selection with conflict handling.
pieces.useHere: Research context and provenance discipline; no HAXR data imported.
pieces.integration: Preserve source coordinates, dataset clocks, license, station identity and hashes. Never relocate Hamburg measurements to Helsinki.

pieces.existing: Explicit bounded acquisition-window skew; retains unmatched frames.
pieces.useHere: Assumes consistent fixture clocks and makes that limitation explicit.
pieces.integration: Carry uncertainty in source clocks separately from transport delay; do not infer correction.

pieces.existing: Causal read-only display of tracker snapshots, with lastSeen age and bounded trails.
pieces.useHere: Latest observation is selected by event time. No tracker or estimates are represented by the dots.
pieces.integration: Keep estimates in a distinct layer with estimator/version and parent observation IDs.

pieces.existing: SQLite queue, message IDs, payloads, priority, createdAt, retry counts and ACK state.
pieces.useHere: Executed by the optional local workbench: two actual SQLite queues; original observation IDs and source timestamps inside CBOR payloads.
pieces.integration: Enqueue original observation ID and event time inside the payload. Queue creation/lastAttempt time is not observation time. Receiver must persist its own receipt time and retain retries separately.

pieces.existing: CBOR delivery using X-Message-Id, retry/circuit-breaker handling, queue ACK/NACK and bounded sender deduplication.
pieces.useHere: Executed by the optional local workbench: actual POST retries, persistent receiver receipts and separate accepted records.
pieces.integration: Receiver-side idempotence must survive restart. Sender sent-ID memory is not evidence of receiver observation history.

pieces.existing: Canonical CBOR HMAC signing and chained audit events with key rotation support.
pieces.useHere: Not executed; public export is explicitly unsigned SHA-256.
pieces.integration: Use the existing signer and persistence in a hosted receiver, with verification and retained key identity; never put a signing secret into this public page.

pieces.existing: Redacted evidence references with completeness, missing/degraded states and producer metadata.
pieces.useHere: The specimen exposes fixture provenance and limits, not agent-internal traces.
pieces.integration: Link run/source/receipt references and explicit completeness; do not export raw prompts, completions or hidden reasoning.

raivariTests.checkout: abe8b915; inspected replay source and these test files have no diff against the pinned origin/main revision

validation.runtimeBoundary: Authored replay remains static. The optional local workbench runs actual offline queues and burst-sync. Signing remains unconnected. No physical station network or operational validation.

capture.modifications: Header and skip-link hidden only to prevent fixed-position overlays entering the element capture. Plot and data unchanged.
